module: Transform session (move, rotate, scale) of the selected objects for Easy Object Select. begin() stores the initial transform and scale of each selected object; the update* functions reposition the objects from the initial state (not cumulative); finish() records the result in the editor history (SetObjectTransform / SetObjectScale, undoable, in a transaction); cancel() restores everything. Also handles prefab offset updates and reset to upright.
notes: Only one session at a time (local upvalue). begin fails if the anchor is not selected or if an object cannot be manipulated (editor.canManipulateObject).
Scale is clamped to [0.01, 1000] per component; the factor is identical for all edited axes and bounded so that all objects stay within that range.
finish() creates no history action if there is no net change: the objects are then restored.
The onEditorObjectSelectionTransformChanged hook is emitted only on undo/redo of the actions (applyHistoryTransform/Scale), not during the session.
finish() returns false without a session, nil if the history transaction could not be opened, otherwise hasNetChange (boolean) then completion.

begin.desc: Opens a session on all objects of editor.selection.object. Returns false if a session already exists, if the anchor is not selected or if an object cannot be manipulated.

anchorObject.desc: Anchor object (its position is the reference for surface grabbing and distance).

options.desc: historyName (string, name of the history transaction, default "EasySelectDrag").

returns.desc: true if the session is open.

setGrabSurface.desc: Sets the offset between the grabbed surface point and the anchor position.

maintainRelativeZ.desc: If false, the vertical offset is set to 0.

verticalOffset.desc: If provided, forces the vertical offset (takes precedence over maintainRelativeZ).

returns.desc: false without a session or without surfacePosition.

getDesiredAnchorPosition.desc: Computes the desired anchor position for a surface point (surface - grabOffset), with optional grid snapping.

returns.desc: Anchor position, or false if no session / no grabOffset / no point.

updateDelta.desc: Translates all objects by delta relative to their initial position, with optional grid snapping (per-axis mask, absolute or relative).

options.desc: gridSize (m), gridPivot (vec3), gridMask ({x,y,z} booleans), gridRelative (boolean), snapZ (boolean).

returns.desc: false without a session or without delta.

updateRotation.desc: Rotates all objects (orientation and position) around the pivot, from the initial state.

axis.desc: Axis (normalized internally; zero length is rejected).

updateScale.desc: Scales the objects around the pivot along the given axes; positions are stretched relative to the pivot.

axes.desc: Axes x, y, z used to stretch the positions.

factors.desc: Factors {x, y, z}; an axis is "edited" if its factor differs from 1.

update.desc: Moves the selection so that the anchor follows a surface point; can align each object to the surface normal and use an individual position/normal provider.

options.desc: gridSize, gridRelative, snapZ, followRotation (boolean), rotateSnapSize (degrees), rotateRelative (boolean), individualProvider (function(entry, position) -> {position, normal}|nil). The parameter must be a table (inferred from code: options.followRotation is read without a guard).

returns.desc: false if no session or no grabOffset.

finish.desc: Ends the session: if there is a net change, opens a history transaction and records a SetObjectTransform and/or SetObjectScale action per object; otherwise restores the initial state.

returns.desc: true if change committed, false if no change (or no session), nil if the transaction could not be opened.

cancel.desc: Cancels the session and restores the initial transform and scale of each object.

returns.desc: true if a session was active.

resetRotation.desc: Resets the objects to upright (world Z axis) while keeping their heading, in a "ResetObjectRotation" history transaction. Refuses if a session is active.

objectIds.desc: IDs of the objects to straighten.

returns.desc: true if at least one object changed.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether a session is open.

selectionMatches.desc: Checks that the editor selection is still exactly the session's selection and that the objects remain manipulable.

returns.desc: true without a session or if the selection matches.
List of IDs (empty without a session).
